passages.provision_quote: That Section 31 of Article I thereof is repealed.
passages.note: Bill-text page prints the operative repeal of Prop 209's ban on race/sex preferences; it names no voter.
Assembly floor vote page lists Ramos among the Ayes on ACA 5 final passage; it prints no provision text.

rows.reasoning: In his earlier Assembly term, Ramos voted Aye on ACA 5 (2019-2020), whose operative text states 'That Section 31 of Article I thereof is repealed,' removing the constitutional bar on race, sex, ethnicity and national-origin preferences in public employment, education and contracting and so permitting affirmative-action programs to resume. A measure that only permits such programs does not itself strengthen civil rights enforcement, so it cannot establish the full compound rung text 'strengthen civil rights enforcement and address systemic discrimination' — at most it touches addressing systemic discrimination, leaving the enforcement clause unmatched, so the row is BLANK compound-partial.
